en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large ornamental fountain with a central statue in a circular basin, surrounded by landscaped park greenery. Water jets arch around the statue. The caption below reads "GRAZ, Stadtpark - Brunnen." An oval red advertisement in the upper right corner says "Schichts Seifen die besten." There is also fine print along the left edge naming the publisher.
